## Professional Summary

Experienced biostatistician specializing in Bayesian methods and Predictive Probability of Success (PoS) for clinical trials. Expert in developing statistical frameworks for OS-PFS prediction models in oncology.

- Led internal methodology workshops on predictive probability applications

### Biostatistician
